itens.descricao_en: Computer use CLI for AI agents
itens.readme:
# agent-desktop
Computer use for AI agents: see and operate desktop apps on macOS, Windows, and Linux through the OS accessibility tree.
agent-desktop gives an AI agent computer use without screenshots or pixel matching. It reads the accessibility tree of a desktop app and returns it as JSON, with a ref for every element the agent can act on. The agent clicks or types on a ref, reads the UI again to check the result, and repeats. The loop lives in your agent; agent-desktop has no model inside. It ships as a CLI and a C library.
Snapshots, clipboard reads, screenshots, command output, and debug artifacts can contain private desktop content. Keep them out of public logs and uploads.
## Install
```bash
npm install -g agent-desktop
agent-desktop status                # platform, permissions, supported surfaces
agent-desktop permissions --guide   # macOS: walks you through the Accessibility grant
```
Bun, Yarn and pnpm can install the same package. It includes native binaries and platform helpers for x64 and ARM64.
For direct execution without a JavaScript launcher, download the matching native archive from
[GitHub Releases](https://github.com/vercel-labs/agent-desktop/releases) and keep its helper beside the executable.
On macOS and Linux, Homebrew also works: `brew install agent-desktop`. There is no official Scoop package yet.
The repository no longer maintains a custom Homebrew tap or Scoop bucket.
Release archives and building from source are covered in [Installation](https:/

itens.descricao_en: Auto Ontology is a Python framework for building semantic, graph-based reasoning layers over data. It enables deterministic query generation, better context retrieval, and more explainable AI for LLM and agent workflows.
itens.readme:
# Auto Ontology
Agents can retrieve documents and query databases, but reliability gates agentic analytics: a revenue metric answered faster is worth nothing if the number is wrong. Agents need a context layer that tells them where data lives, what it means, whether to use it, how to use it, where it came from, and what is similar. NVIDIA Auto Ontology is an open library that builds that layer from enterprise metadata, reconciles definitions across systems, and exposes it to any agent harness through MCP, CLI, and API. It complements the semantic models customers already own.
It enables developers to:
- Discover: generate enterprise ontologies from metadata; connect existing ontologies and semantic models; build AI-ready knowledge graphs.
- Ground: give agents trusted business meaning for metrics, entities, and relationships; reconcile inconsistent definitions across systems.
- Validate: check generated queries against certified definitions and lineage; return provenance with every answer.
- Expose: serve context to any agent harness through MCP, CLI, and API.
Learn: fold certified corrections and usage back into the ontology, so shared context improves with every question.
## Benchmarks
To run a text-to-SQL benchmark such as BIRD, refer to the
[ontology SQL evaluation repository](https://github.com/NVIDIA/ontology-sql-eval/).

Disc Image Studio 可将一张图片转换成符合 CD、DVD 与单层 BD-R 光盘物理层约束的数据，刻录后将使光盘盘面呈现肉眼可见的图案。

Windows 下载 `win-x64.exe` 后可直接运行。Linux 或 macOS 请下载与 CPU 匹配的**实验性 CLI** 压缩包，解压后运行 `./disc-image-studio --help`。这些发布包均自带 .NET 运行时。 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/releases)

在主页选择 CD、DVD 或蓝光，指定输出位置后创建工程。

在设计页导入图片，用图层完成排版，并在右栏「影调」模块调整抖动、伽马、亮度与灰阶档位。

在预览页核对盘面投影，在导出页生成 ISO / RAW / WAV+CUE，或使用即时刻录功能直接写入空白盘片。
即时刻录为实验性功能，请只使用可报废的测试介质。
## 功能

- **CD 支持**：支持任何 CD 。您可导出带格式头的 WAV 音轨及配套 CUE，兼容 cdrecord, ImgBurn等刻录软件；也允许导出 RAW 音轨。详见 [CD 刻录兼容说明](docs/CD_AUDIO_COMPATIBILITY.md)。
- **DVD 支持**：支持任何 DVD。您可导出 ISO 镜像。
- **蓝光支持**：支持任何单层 BD-R 25 GB，支持纯绘图与 UDF 2.01 文件。详见 [ADDING_BLURAY.md](docs/ADDING_BLURAY.md)。
- **随盘文件**：CD／DVD／蓝光可在设计页直接选择要保存的文件夹及内圈／外圈位置，也可在导出页调整；设置随工程保存。

- **介质灰度方案**：CD 与 DVD 均使用黑白二阶，CD 使用 `0D / AA`，DVD 扰码域使用 `A5 / 92`。详见 [PHYSICAL_MODEL_AUDIT.md](docs/PHYSICAL_MODEL_AUDIT.md)。
- **灰度抖动工具**：独立程序也可将原图处理为 `0/255` 黑白二阶 PNG；支持打开或拖入原图、并排预览及无损 PNG 导出。详见[使用与构建说明](tools/FourLevelDither/README.md)。

## What is Floci?
Floci is a free, open-source local AWS emulator for development, testing, and CI.
It gives you AWS-shaped services on your machine without requiring a cloud account, an auth token, or paid feature gates. Point your AWS SDK, CLI, Terraform, CDK, OpenTofu, or test suite at `http://localhost:4566` and keep your existing workflows.
Already using LocalStack? Floci is a drop-in replacement: swap the image and keep going. See [Migrating from LocalStack](#migrating-from-localstack).
Floci is the AWS member of the [Floci](https://github.com/floci-io) emulator family, named after [floccus](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cirrocumulus_floccus), the cloud formation that looks like popcorn.
| Emulator | Cloud | Port |
|---|---|:---:|
| **[floci](https://github.com/floci-io/floci)** | **AWS** | **4566** |
| [floci-az](https://github.com/floci-io/floci-az) | Azure | 4577 |
| [floci-gcp](https://github.com/floci-io/floci-gcp) | GCP | 4588 |
| [floci-oci](https://github.com/floci-io/floci-oci) | OCI | 4599 |
## Quick Start
The fastest way to run Floci is with the official [CLI](https://github.com/floci-io/floci-cli)
```bash
floci start
```
No Docker? Each [release](https://github.com/floci-io/floci/releases) also ships a standalone `floci-aws`

Spec Kit is an open source toolkit that gives AI coding agents structured

## Choose your process

| Decide whether an idea deserves investment | [Idea assessment](#idea-assessment) | An evidence-backed go, clarify, or stop decision |
| Adopt or create a different process | [Your own process](#capabilities) | A process adapted or assembled from reusable primitives |
These are independent entry points, not mandatory phases. SDD ships in core;
bug fixing and assessment are bundled extensions you install when needed, and
